sn47.31:1.2: Ayaṃ kāye kāyānupassanā ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || ||
sn47.31:1.3: Sā kho panāyam kāye kāyanupassanā bhāvetabbā ti me bhikkhave ||
sn47.31:1.4: bhavitā ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || || 4.
sn47.31:4.2: sā kho panāyaṃ dhammesu dhammānupassanā bhāvetabbā ti me bhikkhave ||
sn47.31:4.3: bhāvitā ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādīti || || 1--2.
